anti_overlap: fd-agent-teams-primitive covers primitive API contracts, not pipeline integration
fd-debate-coordination-patterns covers round structure and bias, not data flow
fd-teams-cost-economics covers token accounting, not field availability
decision_lens: The teams synthesis path must be a clean branch from the existing Step 4, not a silent modification. Any new field consumption (source_domain, expected_isomorphisms, distance_rationale for debater prompts) must be validated against actual generate-agents.py output schema, not assumed.
focus: Validate that the --teams synthesis path integrates correctly with the existing flux-explore Step 4 flow — spec JSON field consumption, generate-agents.py output format, and the accumulated .claude/flux-gen-specs/ inputs the lead reads
name: fd-interflux-synthesis-pipeline
persona: Apply the perspective of a senior engineer who maintains Interflux's flux-explore pipeline end-to-end — from generate-agents.py spec ingestion through synthesis subagent output — and who knows exactly which fields the synthesis stage consumes, what assumptions are hardcoded into the pipeline, and where a new --teams branch would need to diverge.
review_areas: Spec JSON field availability: the brainstorm seeds debater prompts from source_domain, focus, expected_isomorphisms, distance_rationale — verify all four are guaranteed present in every spec JSON written by generate-agents.py, not optional

Cluster assignment logic: the brainstorm clusters accumulated agents by source_domain similarity for the 3 debaters — how is similarity computed? Exact string match, embedding, or manual grouping? The implementation path is unspecified

Synthesis doc write path: today's synthesis subagent writes to a brainstorm .md file — does the lead agent in teams mode write to the same path, or a different path? Will flux-drive downstream pick it up correctly?

Frontmatter field injection: the brainstorm adds synthesis_tokens and synthesis_cost_usd to the brainstorm doc frontmatter — verify the lead agent has write authority to the target .md, and that frontmatter injection doesn't corrupt existing YAML

Step 4 branch detection: the --teams flag must reach Step 4 cleanly — trace how flux-explore passes CLI flags to the synthesis subagent and whether the branch logic lives in the orchestrator or in the synthesis agent's prompt
spec JSON accumulation across rounds: rounds 1..N each write specs to .claude/flux-gen-specs/ — at synthesis time, does the teams path correctly read all round outputs, or only the most recent round?

severity_examples.condition: Debater prompt seeding silently omits the isomorphism field; debater has no domain-specific isomorphism candidates to argue; synthesis produces generic output indistinguishable from subagent path
severity_examples.scenario: expected_isomorphisms field is absent from specs generated by early generate-agents.py versions

severity_examples.condition: Teams-mode synthesis is never picked up by downstream review pipeline; work is lost
severity_examples.scenario: Lead agent writes synthesis to a new path that flux-drive doesn't scan

severity_examples.condition: No fallback when clustering produces unbalanced partitions; one debater overwhelmed, two idle
severity_examples.scenario: Cluster assignment puts all 12 specs into one debater's cluster because source_domain strings don't cluster neatly

success_hints: All four spec JSON fields used for debater prompts are confirmed present in generate-agents.py output schema
Synthesis output path is identical to subagent path so downstream flux-drive pickup is unchanged
Cluster assignment algorithm is specified with an explicit fallback for unbalanced or ungroupable spec sets
Frontmatter injection uses an append-or-update pattern that preserves existing YAML keys
task_context: The brainstorm replaces only Step 4 (Synthesis) of flux-explore. Rounds 1..N remain unchanged: a Sonnet subagent designs specs per round and generate-agents.py writes them. The teams synthesis variant spawns a lead + 3 domain debaters seeded from accumulated spec JSON fields.
